caption: Arctic Wolf Metadata
description: The Arctic Wolf metadata object describes Arctic Wolf platform-specific attributes associated with the event, including the customer, deployment, monitored attack surfaces, and telemetry type.
name: arcticwolf_metadata

attack_surface_uids.description: The normalized identifiers of the attack surfaces that generated or are associated with the event.

attack_surfaces.description: The Arctic Wolf attack surfaces that generated or are associated with the event. For example Web Application (WAF) or Email Security.

customer.description: The Arctic Wolf customer associated with the event.

deployment.description: The Arctic Wolf deployment associated with the event.

ingestion_service.description: The Arctic Wolf service associated with the event.
